description: cc-memory (calm) hooks for Codex CLI. Claude Code版はhooks/hooks.json。MessageDisplayはCodexに対応イベントが無いため未登録（表示専用機能の代替は別issueで検討）。

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec uv run python hooks/hook_state.py clear
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec uv run python hooks/session_start_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec uv run python hooks/sanitize_backfill_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec uv run python hooks/stop_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec uv run python hooks/user_prompt_submit_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec uv run python hooks/preblock_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec uv run python hooks/relay_monitor_watch_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec uv run python hooks/sanitize_tool_result_hook.py
